Video games, brought to life

TorqFall

It's basically Fall Guys — with RC buggies · Standalone event #1

A pack of buggies charges a chaos gauntlet. Bump, pile up, survive. Chaos hides mistakes, so beginners thrive — and the overhead pile-up is pure content gold.

How it plays

  • 6–12 cars per heat through a soft-obstacle gauntlet — noodle gates, foam fields, a swinging pendulum, a sweeper bar.
  • Race mode (first to finish) or survival mode (last car moving) — switch by crowd size.
  • A whole-day tournament arc: non-elim qualifying → bracket → a crowned Grand Final.
  • No skill wall — everyone crashes, everyone laughs. Knocked-out drivers keep driving in free-play laps.

See it move

The overhead pile-up at the first funnel and the sweeper wipe-out are the money frames.

The level directory

21+ rounds built from one modular kit, shuffled so no two heats feel the same. Three difficulty tiers escalate into the day's climax.

Tier 1

Qualifiers

Funnel Dash · Noodle Weave · Block Field · Roller Rush

High-chaos, low-skill, everyone advances.

Tier 2

Bracket

Pendulum Pass · Twin Sweepers · Spinner Gate · The Chicane

Active obstacles that actually sort drivers.

Tier 3

Finals

Full Gauntlet · Hex-a-Fall · King of the Hill · Collapse Gate

Survival, elimination — the reel + the champion.

The Collapse Gate — the Tier-3 finish is a breakable wall every survivor punches through. It gives every player the smash payoff and field-tests the TorqSiege collapse mechanic live, at near-zero cost. One round, double duty.

Why it works

For beginners

Chaos hides skill. Non-elim qualifying + respawns + free-play laps mean nobody stands around benched.

For content

Overhead pile-ups, sweeper wipe-outs, photo-finishes, a crowned champion. Fastest to shoot, cheapest to build.
